title: T04b — Run the placement campaign on the enrolled Mac and mini PC
goal: Run the placement campaign on the enrolled Mac and mini PC.
privacy: Repository-owned neutral fixtures; do not send private inputs to another inference host or enable services/devices without existing authorization.
acceptance: Run the placement campaign on the enrolled Mac and mini PC
validation: Directed regressions or recorded evidence for this slice; final required CI
escalation: Stop on unclear ownership, missing prerequisites, privacy changes or uncertain external effects
Escalate repeated tool failures or inadequate context; no automatic cloud fallback

effort.basis: Owner-approved slice, 2026-11-11 (PR #264). Slice T04b of the step "Compare NERV Mac and mini PC role placement". Estimate, not a measurement. Numbers backfilled 2026-11-11 at harness 5.4.0 from this estimate (rounded up to a quarter day); the baseline is this estimate, not an original one. Re-estimated 2026-11-11 in agent hours (harness 5.6.0): 1.5 hours agent + 0.5 hours owner; agent prepares, checks and records the real-model campaign on two machines (machine time not counted); the owner starts the approved run. Method: a judged rate of about 1.5 agent hours per former focused day, not a calculation, informed by NERV merge history (50 feature and fix PRs #140–#276, previous merge to merge, a throughput proxy: median about 0.56 h, p75 2.1–2.7 h by quantile method, p90 about 5.1 h) and B-046-T02 (2-day estimate, about 0.75 h stated to implement); a step that is a PR of its own takes at least 0.75 h with review and CI, while an agent part that only prepares or records for an owner step may be less. Machine time of real-model or device runs is not counted. Estimate, not a measurement; baselineDays 1 kept as history.
